llm_response:
CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is related to JSON parsing in FastAPI when handling multi-line text in a request body. The error occurs because JSON strings cannot contain literal newline characters - they need to be escaped as "\n" in the JSON. The solution is purely conceptual and involves properly formatting the JSON request by escaping newline characters in the "doc" field. This can be verified without building or running the code, as it's a standard JSON formatting issue. The user simply needs to modify their request to use escaped newlines like `"doc": "this is test.\nthis is test too."` instead of including literal newlines in the JSON string. This is a common JSON parsing issue that doesn't require setting up a build environment to understand or verify.
